title: Profile
description:
A named dkr profile: settings applied to `docker run` for one image.
Only `image` is required.

env.description:
Environment variables passed into the container (`-e KEY=VALUE`).
Values support `~` and `$VAR`/`${VAR}` expansion.

extra_args.description: Raw extra `docker run` flags, appended verbatim before the image.

image.description: The docker image to run, e.g. "myorg/myimage:latest".

init.description:
Run docker's `--init` so the container's main process isn't PID 1,
meaning it gets normal signal handling (e.g. Ctrl-C actually works).
Defaults to true; set to false to opt out.

user.description: User to run as inside the container, e.g. "1000:1000" (`-u`).

Volume.description: A bind mount: `host` is mounted into the container at `container`.

container.description: Path inside the container to mount it at.

host.description: Host path to mount. Supports `~` and `$VAR`/`${VAR}` expansion.

options.description: Extra mount options appended after a third `:`, e.g. "ro".
